fact: No Beninese text specifically governs AI systems as of August 2026, and the ethics and responsibility text promised by the 2023-2027 AI strategy has produced no identifiable bill; Article 576 of the Digital Code was cited by the CNIN on 29 May 2026 for AI-altered images of a person (five years and 25 million FCFA).
title: L'intelligence artificielle au Bénin : enjeux et perspectives juridiques
